Name: Meshillemith
Summary: Father of Meshullam in the Jerusalem priest list, son of Immer.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:12: Father of Meshullam in the Jerusalem priest list, son of Immer.
LifeLesson: The mention of Meshillemith in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
